findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "support-agent-admin" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: admin__get_agent, admin__get_chat, admin__get_crm_unreplied_alert_config, admin__list_connectors · Private data: admin__get_chat, admin__import_contacts, admin__send_message, admin__send_followup, admin__get_attachment_content, admin__upload_attachments, admin__set_attachment_visibility, admin__bulk_delete_sessions, admin__export_contacts · Public sink: admin__get_chat, admin__update_agent, admin__send_message, admin__send_followup, admin__upload_attachments, admin__set_attachment_visibility, admin__get_crm_unreplied_alert_config, admin__update_crm_unreplied_alert_config, admin__upload_agent_icon, admin__compose_draft, admin__set_x_account_daily_limits, admin__set_x_account_attention, admin__preview_followup_email, admin__invite_agent_collaborator, admin__list_connectors · Destructive: admin__delete_agent, admin__delete_attachment, admin__bulk_delete_sessions, admin__assign_whatsapp_account, admin__assign_instagram_account, admin__set_x_account_attention, admin__assign_telegram_account, admin__assign_jiji_account, admin__assign_smtp_account, admin__get_followup_run, admin__resume_followup_run, admin__remove_agent_collaborator, admin__run_scan, admin__delete_scans, admin__delete_scan_schedule, admin__trigger_scan_schedule, sheets__create_sheet, sheets__generate_sheet, sheets__list_sheets, sheets__get_sheet, sheets__update_sheet, sheets__delete_sheet, docs__create_doc, docs__list_docs, docs__get_doc, docs__rewrite_doc, docs__delete_doc, calendar__add_event, calendar__check_events_today, calendar__check_events_week, calendar__convert_timezone, calendar__update_event, calendar__delete_event.
